input.per_image_size_limit: 不超过30 MB；官方未说明MB是十进制或MiB，实现宜保守使用30,000,000字节
input.pixel_limit_formula: total pixels < 4096 * 4096; not documented as an independent 4096px cap on each edge
input.unknowns: 此创建页没有列最小边、独立每边限制、宽高比范围或总正文上限；不能移用Seed3D的300–6000/0.4–2.5/64MB条件。

project_reference_conversion.operation: lossless re-encode decoded RGBA pixels as PNG, no resize/padding/synthesis
provenance: reopened PNG decoded RGBA exact equality
project_reference_conversion.reason: WebP is not among documented Ark Hyper3D inputs; same pixels preserve the Seed3D/Hitem input comparison.

text.image_text_constraints: Ark允许图+可选英文文本，未进一步承诺文字不会改变身份。项目首试宜只传规格flags，避免描述另造角色。

seed.transport: top-level JSON integer field seed; not --seed text flag
seed.reproducibility: same request and seed produce similar, not guaranteed identical, results

input.callback_url: optional top-level callback_url; no callback needed for local poll/download workflow

multiple_images_vs_multiview.documented: 1–5 image inputs in one task are supported.
not_exposed_in_ark_schema: same subject versus different subject fusion rule
multiple_images_vs_multiview.claim_boundary: 多张输入已支持；无法仅凭该字段宣称具有相机校准、多视角融合或photogrammetry级别的身份/几何保证。厂商旧版condition_mode、concat等参数不可直接搬入Ark。
multiple_images_vs_multiview.project_selection: 若将来试多图，先挑同角色同版本且经过实看的真实不同角度；连续表情帧不是多视角；Seed3D推断背面的渲染仍是派生假设，多次喂入不使其变为网络原型证据。

quality_override.type: number in Ark table; prefer integral face count locally

geometry.recommendation_annotation: 官方另写建议quality_override>=150000；这是建议而非请求下限，与Quad默认18000并存。对编辑底模实验可明确选择18k或50k，不应为此盲目堆面。

project_trial_target.rationale: 官方Quad high档，较18k更有机会保留眼嘴/轮廓细节，较现有高面Seed3D更轻；参数不改变官方固定每任务价格。18k适合更轻的编辑实验但并不省API费。

TAPose.true: 对类人模型强制生成T-Pose或A-Pose，由模型选择T还是A。
TAPose.false: Ark仅说不强制，由模型自行决定。
TAPose.reason: 当前Ark接口没有bone_template、skeleton、skinning或animation参数，也没有保证输出bones/joints/weights。标准静态姿态只是后续绑定准备，不是已绑定。
TAPose.identity_caveat: 奶蛙短肢/无颈形象不一定适合通用类人重摆姿；首试保持同源输入，避免姿态条件改变体型。
TAPose.observed_trial: TAPose=false was submitted; this generated trial nevertheless has two additional outstretched arms alongside the source belly-holding pair. No causal attribution is established.

bbox_condition.default_recommendation: omit unless necessary, let model infer bounds
bbox_condition.project_caveat: 示例[100,100,100]不是角色真实尺寸，不宜照搬为角色正方体比例要求。

geometry.editing_readiness: Quad不自动意味着合理的关节edge loops、分离四肢、无自交、可绑定或变形可靠；必须检查原始拓扑和肢体连接。

addons.ark_claims_only: 增强纹理贴图分辨率；未承诺额外高模、多模型格式、骨骼、额外动作或其它附件。
addons.actual_channel_packing_or_files: not specified; inspect archive and texture dimensions

hd_texture.ark_documented_effect: enable/disable HD texture; no exact resolution or algorithm specified

native_vendor_context.Gen2_HighPack: Vendor says 2K to 4K pack textures only, no geometry change or extra high-poly model.
native_vendor_context.hd_texture: Vendor describes additional texture super-resolution/enhancement with possible artifacts, not final 2K/4K selection.
native_vendor_context.applicability: Descriptive native context only; Ark actual files/behavior still need a real controlled trial.

materials_and_textures.delivery_observation: Requested PBR and HighPack did not produce a delivered material/texture bundle in this trial: the direct OBJ contains UV but no mtllib/usemtl/material/color and has no delivered texture dependencies. Capability/request flags are not delivery evidence.

output.download_container: detect actual response bytes; one observed OBJ trial returned direct OBJ despite documented ZIP
output.inside_zip: If a ZIP is returned, inspect its actual files. This trial delivered a direct OBJ, so no ZIP/MTL/texture files may be assumed.
output.combination_matrix: Ark lists Quad/Raw, PBR/Shaded/All/None and formats independently; it provides no explicit compatibility matrix or guarantee of native quad persistence for each Quad+PBR+format combination. Verify real archive.

native_quad_preservation.preferred_master: untouched provider artifact plus hash; for this trial files/model.obj is the native Quad master. Retain original ZIP only when an archive was actually delivered.
native_quad_preservation.verification: Count vertex references per original OBJ f-line, record face-size histogram and n==4 fraction before using trimesh or any triangulating importer. Inspect UVs/material references, non-manifold edges, separate parts and source hashes.
native_quad_preservation.GLB_role: useful PBR rendering/interchange; do not label it proof of retained native quadrilateral topology
native_quad_preservation.existing_project_limit: package-character.py/trimesh processing triangulates representation; its exported character.obj is a triangle diffuse exchange, not the provider-native Quad OBJ. Keep native_quad source separate, never overwrite it.

output.safe_handling: Save signed responses privately, detect the downloaded payload format, retain original bytes/hash, validate paths/dependencies before importing; do not read or publish signed URLs in metadata summaries.

cancellation.succeeded_or_failed: delete task record only; later queries unavailable
cancellation.budget_consequence: Cannot use DELETE as a running-job budget brake; deleting a successful record does not undo its usage.

billing_and_quota.billing_basis: successful output 3D files; preserve actual usage and bill for reconciliation
billing_and_quota.parameter_surcharges_in_ark: Current creation page states fixed 30000 tokens/model, price table lists one Hyper3D Gen2 row for all material modes. No separate surcharge is listed for Quad/Raw, quality_override, HD texture or HighPack; do not import vendor credit add-on pricing into Ark.
billing_and_quota.failed_without_successful_output: not charged under successful-output rule; preserve terminal error/usage instead of assuming every timeout is a failure
billing_and_quota.quota_owner: per-model allowance shared under main account and subaccounts; not per API key
billing_and_quota.instruction_for_this_research: 用户已确认此模型有独立免费额度并明确授权开始；总量及账号余额未知。一次授权同图试制已经成功，实际计量30000，预留0。复用既有任务/文件，不重复POST，不从官方初始赠额推算其真实余额。

quota_query.auth: Access Key signed request only; not Ark Bearer inference key
quota_query.constraint: No authenticated account query performed; do not ask for broad AK merely to finish local planning.

minimum_meaningful_trial.purpose: same reviewed existing naiwa image, Quad 50k + PBR + native OBJ; isolate topology and identity trade-off against existing Seed3D model
minimum_meaningful_trial.free_or_paid_status: user confirmed independent free allowance exists; quantity/current balance and settled cash charge not measured
minimum_meaningful_trial.next_trials: No additional retry for this result. Preserve it as a rejected character failure sample / benchmark; do not infer usability from all-Quad topology.
minimum_meaningful_trial.observed_delivery: native Quad OBJ with UV, no delivered materials/textures, and visually rejected extra pair of arms (four arms total)

native.rigging: Separate native /api/v2/rigging supports bone_template and skeleton/skinning/animation workflows; Ark generation schema does not expose or confer this service.

do_not_transplant: native credit/add-on charges or retention rules

value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.value: Introduce a second geometry representation aimed at inspection, editing and later manual rigging, while retaining existing Seed3D PBR identity/reference masters.
value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.limit: native quads and useful deformation loops must be verified; a converted triangle OBJ does not satisfy it.

value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.value: Potential future joint use of real same-version views, unlike Seed3D single-image production API.
value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.limit: Ark does not document calibrated MultiView semantics; inferred render angles remain inferred.

value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.value: Potential optional static neutral-base experiment for suitable humanoid character references.
value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.limit: not automatic rigging; may alter short-limbed mascot identity, so do not enable by default.

value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.value: Compare material look and close-up texture delivery without rebuilding every shot; preserve raw outputs.
value_for_existing_Seed3D_library.limit: PBR preservation in native OBJ/MTL and HighPack artifacts must be checked.

notes: The user-provided quadrupedal mech pure-text example demonstrates service syntax, not an authorized project character design reference. Project characters continue to require actual existing image attachments.
Reference-bound character rebuilding is a local candidate workflow; no official character canon, media rights, animation readiness or publication permission follows from API success.

The original public-document research did not invoke inference. A later explicitly authorized root execution completed one trial; this metadata reconciliation did not call APIs, read credentials or inspect raw signed output URLs.

Root visually confirmed source-versus-output identity failure: the source has two belly-holding arms, while the generated model retains those and adds two outstretched arms. Record rejected_extra_limbs plus missing_materials; TAPose=false did not prevent it, cause unknown, no additional retry.

initial_trial_state.next_trials: Only after inspecting identity/native quad histogram/materials should an optional T/A-pose or real multiple-image experiment be considered; each extra successful task is another 30000 tokens.

preview_separation.visual_comparison: The gallery should expose source versus failed four-arm gray preview; neither native Quad statistics nor preview packaging counts as identity acceptance.

actual_observations.recovery: Already-completed task with a visually rejected four-arm character. Preserve task ID, original artifact, accounting and failure benchmark. Do not repeat POST or append a retry.

visual_review.method: root actual view_image comparison of existing source and generated gray preview
visual_review.observed_failure: Original belly-holding arms remain and an additional pair of outstretched arms is present.
visual_review.cause: not established; do not infer service/parameter handling from the observation

documentation_discrepancies.documented_claim: Query API describes generated model files as ZIP downloads.
documentation_discrepancies.observed: This one completed obj-format task returned direct OBJ bytes.
documentation_discrepancies.handling: Preserve both documentary claim and observed result, detect payload type, and do not generalize the direct-OBJ observation to GLB/FBX/other formats.

documentation_discrepancies.documented_capability: PBR/HighPack and OBJ are listed as request options; no complete per-format delivery matrix is documented.
documentation_discrepancies.observed: PBR+HighPack was requested, but the saved direct OBJ has UV and no material/color/MTL directives/texture files.
documentation_discrepancies.handling: Record material delivery as missing for this artifact. Do not label PBR completeness, textured identity or image-to-video readiness as passed; do not auto-submit another job.
